title: Active Number Response
description: The phone number that has been bought by a customer and assigned to a project.

projectId.description: Project ID. Your project ID can be found on your [Sinch Customer Dashboard](https://dashboard.sinch.com/settings/project-management).

displayName.description: User supplied name for the phone number.

paymentIntervalMonths.description: How often the recurring price is charged in months.

nextChargeDate.description: The date of the next charge.

expireAt.description: The timestamp when the subscription will expire if an expiration date has been set.

callbackUrl.description: The callback URL to be called for a rented number's provisioning / deprovisioning operations.

x-enumDescriptions.SMS: The SMS product can use the number.
x-enumDescriptions.VOICE: The Voice product can use the number.

NumberCapability.description: The capabilities the phone number supports: SMS, Voice, or both
NumberCapability.title: Capability

x-enumDescriptions.MOBILE: Numbers that belong to a specific range.
x-enumDescriptions.LOCAL: Numbers that are assigned to a specific geographic region.
x-enumDescriptions.TOLL_FREE: Numbers that are free of charge for the calling party but billed for all arriving calls.

PhoneNumber.description: The phone number in [E.164](https://community.sinch.com/t5/Glossary/E-164/ta-p/7537) format with leading `+`. Example `+12025550134`.
PhoneNumber.title: Phone Number

ProvisioningStatus.description: The provisioning status. It will be either `WAITING`, `IN_PROGRESS` or `FAILED`. If the provisioning fails, a reason for the failure will be provided. [See a full list of provisioning error descriptions]<(https://developers.sinch.com/docs/numbers/api-reference/error-codes/provisioning-errors) and troubleshooting recommendations.
ProvisioningStatus.title: Provisioning Status

RegionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the phone number. Example: US, GB or SE.
RegionCode.title: Region Code

ScheduledVoiceProvisioning.description: Represents the ongoing or failed scheduled voice provisioning job. This field will be empty if the number was successfully provisioned provisioned for voice.
ScheduledVoiceProvisioning.title: Scheduled Voice Provisioning

lastUpdatedTime.description: Timestamp when the status was last updated.

x-enumDescriptions.CAMPAIGN_NOT_AVAILABLE: The specified campaign is not available.
x-enumDescriptions.PARTNER_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The third party service is unavailable.
x-enumDescriptions.CAMPAIGN_MNO_REJECTED: The MNO for the campaign was rejected.
x-enumDescriptions.CAMPAIGN_MNO_SUSPENDED: The MNO for the campaign was suspended.
x-enumDescriptions.CAMPAIGN_MNO_REVIEW: The MNO for the campaign is under review.
x-enumDescriptions.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: The credit balance for the account is insufficient to cover the fees.
x-enumDescriptions.TFN_NOT_ALLOWED: The Toll-Free number is not allowed.

SmsErrorCode.description: The error codes that show the reason of failure of a scheduled provisioning
SmsErrorCode.title: SMS Error Code

appId.description: Your app ID for the Voice API. The `appId` can be found in your [Sinch Customer Dashboard](https://dashboard.sinch.com/voice/apps).

VoiceApplicationType.description: The voice application type. Examples are RTC, EST, FAX

VoiceConfiguration.title: VoiceConfiguration
VoiceConfiguration.description: The current voice configuration for this number. During scheduled provisioning, the app ID, service ID, or trunk ID value may be empty in a response if it is still processing or if it has failed. The status of scheduled provisioning will show under a `scheduledVoiceProvisioning` object if it's still running. Once processed successfully, the `appId`/`serviceId`/`trunkId` sent will appear directly under the `voiceConfiguration` object.

lastUpdatedTime.description: Timestamp when the status was last updated.

serviceId.description: The service ID if the type is FAX. The `serviceId` can be found in your [Sinch Customer Dashboard](https://dashboard.sinch.com/fax/services).

trunkId.description: The trunk ID if the type is EST. The `trunkId` can be found in your [Sinch Customer Dashboard](https://dashboard.sinch.com/trunks/your-trunks).

money.description: An object giving details on currency code and the amount charged.

amount.description:
The amount in decimal form.
For example `2.00`.
There are no guarantees on the precision unless documented by the message origin. The amount cannot be updated and is read-only.

money.title: Money

scheduledProvisioning.description: Represents the ongoing or failed scheduled provisioning job. This field will be empty if the number was both successfully provisioned to the SMS platform and linked to the 10DLC campaign.

servicePlanId.description: The SMS service plan that the scheduled provisioning job will configure with the number.

campaignId.description: TCR campaign ID that the scheduled provisioning job will configure with the number.

lastUpdatedTime.description: Timestamp when the status was last updated.

scheduledProvisioning.title: Scheduled Provisioning

smsConfiguration.title: SMS Configuration
smsConfiguration.description:
The current SMS configuration for this number.

Once the `servicePlanId` is sent, it enters scheduled provisioning.

The status of scheduled provisioning will show under a `scheduledProvisioning` object if it's still running. Once processed successfully, the `servicePlanId` sent will appear directly under the `smsConfiguration` object.

servicePlanId.description: The `servicePlanId` can be found in the [Sinch Customer Dashboard](https://dashboard.sinch.com/sms/api/rest). The service plan ID is what ties this number to the configured SMS service.

campaignId.description: Only for US phone numbers. This `campaignId` is required to send SMS traffic to US; click [here](https://community.sinch.com/t5/10DLC/What-is-10DLC/ta-p/7845) to read more about 10DLC A2P messaging. So, it is the current campaign ID for this number. The `campaignId` is found on your TCR platform.
